source: Firebase Test Lab physical Galaxy S25 Ultra, one execution, four ordered cases

result.scope: Foreground synchronous 320-sample public streaming calls, including DSP, GPU completion and output readback; excludes audio-device and network latency

quality.reference: Published standard FP32 ONNX graph, same phone
quality.audioQualityScope: One synthetic four-second noisy speech diagnostic; not broad perceptual validation

qualityTiled.reference: Published standard FP32 ONNX graph, same phone
qualityTiled.audioQualityScope: One synthetic four-second noisy speech diagnostic; not broad perceptual validation

direct.scope: One four-second synthetic noisy speech sample; no alignment, scaling or cropping

tiled.scope: One four-second synthetic noisy speech sample; no alignment, scaling or cropping

analysis.scope: 320-sample public streaming call including DSP, submission, GPU completion, state checks and readback. 32 warmup hops and300 timed hops percase. Excludes initialization, recording/playback, network, and EOF. Single handset and short unpaced run; no sustained power/thermal study. No shader attribution was measured on the phone.

publicResultDisclosure.scope: Public benchmark evidence; personal account, project, provider-location, financial authorization and local filesystem provenance removed.
publicResultDisclosure.originalResultHashScope: Existing result/source hashes identify the original captured records or named artifacts, not this redacted JSON. The adjacent .sha256 file identifies this public JSON.
